learning_data.name: Speech Importance
learning_data.info: How we use speech is very important in our day-to-day lives. The main pillars of speech being nouns, adjectives, verbs, and adverbs respectively. We will look at each one individually to see how these grouped terms define speech.

learning_data.name: Nouns
learning_data.info: Nouns are used to identify people, places, and everything around us, these are the names of objects that we are talking about, for example, words like: table, giraffe, John, Australia are all considered nouns

learning_data.name: Adjectives
learning_data.info: Adjectives are words that are used to describe the condition or properties of a noun i.e. describing words. Examples of adjectives are: red, round, huge,tiled, etc

learning_data.name: Verbs
learning_data.info: Verbs are words that are used to describe an action or state within a sentence. Examples of verbs in sentences include: run, dance, go, destroy, impersonate, develop, and much more.

learning_data.name: Adverbs
learning_data.info: Adverbs are words that modify adjectives, verbs, or adverbs within a word group. These words usually end in ly and examples of them are: sadly, suddenly, often, fast, etc.

learning_data.name: Remember!
learning_data.info: Remember to keep in mind what each of these word types do in order to find out which words belong to which group.
